To find the physical dimension of the square root of an area, we first identify the dimension of area. Area is defined as the measure of a two-dimensional surface, typically calculated as the product of two lengths (e.g., length × width). Therefore, its physical dimension is Length squared:
Dimension(Area) = Length^2

The quantity in question is the square root of an area:
Quantity = √Area

Substituting the dimension of area into this expression:
Dimension(Quantity) = √(Length^2) = (Length^2)^(1/2) = Length^1 = Length

<ANSWER>Length</ANSWER>
